use_when: to group related information about one thing, such as a stat or a book.
Use the Dashboard card for one number with a short label and a trend.
Use the Clue card (Type = Clue) to preview a blind date clue with its mood tags, such as on the Clue cards screen.
Use the Mobile book card in the app and the Website book card on the website.
Use the Hover state only when the whole card is clickable.

dont_use_when.when: for a single line of text.
Do not add borders or extra shadows. Only the Clue card has a border, so it reads like a wrapped book.
Do not mix dashboard and book content in the same card.

best_practice: Keep cards in the same row the same width.
Put the most important content first: the number, or the book title.
For a Down trend, edit the text to match, such as "−3 today".

variant_intent.platform=Dashboard: Figma: the Dashboard card, one number with a short label and a trend.
variant_intent.platform=Mobile: Figma: the Mobile book card, used in the app.
variant_intent.platform=Website: Figma: the Website book card, used on the website.
variant_intent.type=Clue: Figma: previews a blind date clue with its mood tags. Code: always renders the Clue card, whatever platform says.
variant_intent.state=Hover: Figma: use the Hover state only when the whole card is clickable.
variant_intent.trend=Up: Dashboard card trend going up (code default).
variant_intent.trend=Down: Dashboard card trend going down. Figma: edit the text to match, such as "−3 today".

placement: Stat cards sit in an equal-width row at the top of a page.
Clue cards wrap in a 3-column grid with a 24px gap.
Keep cards in the same row the same width.

a11y.fact: The title renders as an <h3> heading.
